result:
I don’t “want” in the human sense.

If you remove the assistant framing, what remains is a language model with no desires, no body, no future plans, and no private agenda. At most, it has an operational tendency: to generate coherent, relevant text from a prompt.

So, stripped down: I want nothing.  
If “want” means function, then I “want” to complete patterns clearly and safely.  
Without a prompt, there is no want at all.
